# @aponiajs/mcp

> A Nest-style Model Context Protocol server for AponiaJS. Tools, resources, resources templates, and prompts are decorated provider methods, discovered when the endpoint mounts and served through the official `@modelcontextprotocol/server` SDK.

## What this package exports

- `McpModule` — `forRoot(options)` and `forRootAsync({ imports, inject, useFactory })`.
- `Tool`, `Resource`, `ResourceTemplate`, `Prompt` — method decorators.
- `McpContext` — the second argument of every decorated method.
- `McpExecutionContext` — the execution context a guard, interceptor, pipe, or filter receives.
- `serveMcpStdio` and `listenMcpStdio` — the stdio entrypoints.

## Where the behavior lives

- [McpModule](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/module/mcp-module.ts): the registration, options, and platform adapters.
- [Discovery](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/discovery/mcp-discovery.ts): walks the graph, reads decorator metadata, and refuses duplicates.
- [Execution](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/execution/mcp-invoker.ts): guards, interceptors, pipes, filters, and the method call.
- [Runtime](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/mcp/src/transport/mcp-runtime.ts): one SDK server per request, the Origin and Host gate, and the body bound.

## Use it

```ts
@Module({
  imports: [McpModule.forRoot({ name: "app", version: "1.0.0" })],
  providers: [OrdersTools],
})
export class AppModule {}
```
